title: Small etale ringed projection presentations and native scalar restriction
statement: For a scheme $T$ [def-pc-scheme], use the common coefficient universe [def-weil-size-convention] and lift only the Hom universe of its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Transport its topology along the canonical ULiftHom equivalence. Define presentationEquivalence by sheafCongr, nativeEquivalence at ModuleCat coefficients, and toNative as the actual constant-scalar restriction [lem-sfb-constant-scalar-restriction-tensor] followed by the inverse site equivalence. Define derivedToNative by localization in the ordinary derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. NativeOrdinaryTensorData is a braided structure on this literal functor, whose tensorator fixes every local pure tensor and whose unit takes a constant scalar to the same constant scalar. NativeTensorData is DerivedComparisonData for that ordinary structure: its specified signed-total tensor comparison, degree-zero unit normalization and Koszul symmetry normalization. Define corner as the small constant-ring site with the canonical localized tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]. ModelNormalized says that every flat-term K-flat representative comparison is the inverse of the localization tensorator. For GeometricData and ExactData [def-sfb-constant-module-geometric-comparison-data], define edge as its actual scalar-extension pullback, K-injective derived direct image and canonical adjunction, retaining the specified scalar-one insertion and pure-tensor comparison, in the existing corner/model/edge interface [def-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-square-presentation]. Define transportedInverse and transportedDirect by conjugating native functors with the site equivalences; ordinaryNativeLeft and ordinaryNativeRight are the ordinary scalar comparisons followed by the explicit equivalence unit cancellation.
